strategyThesis: Productize one AI consulting segment with a fixed service boundary, validated by three paid design partners within 90 days, to increase recurring revenue and reduce delivery variability, while deferring new verticals and partner-led delivery.

decision.text: Productize one segment with a fixed service boundary, validated by three paid design partners within 90 days.
